crossRefs.note: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries…
He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

translations.web: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
translations.bsb: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
translations.kjv: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
translations.asv: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
